text: Redmond Rovers build patiently from a free kick on the left side near midfield, passing six times in just under 20 seconds. Rory Mensah receives a medium pass from Kian Coleman roughly 27 metres from Ironvale Athletic’s goal at the far end. Mensah shoots with his foot from central position outside the penalty area and scores. The ball flies into the net, keeping the score at zero to one with Redmond still trailing. [#682] [#689] [#690]
